Provide exact independent certificate interfaces for both soundness and completeness. A rank upper bound is not a minimum, a finite plateau is not stabilization, a root count is not an ideal or root-set equality, and an abstract theorem does not establish concrete input hypotheses.

Give explicit operations/units, full raw counts, exact aggregation/denominators, censoring and uncertainty. No free advice, reuse or hidden amortization.

Provide proof_search_map baseline reproduction, observation-collision search, quantifier order, method ceiling and nearby known-false object. Separate well-definedness, correctness, completeness, size/time/memory, probability, interface and scope obligations. A passed audit supplies no asymptotic or cryptanalytic promotion.

Keep dominated_by explicitly unresolved unless every relevant time/memory/data/query frontier row is actually checked. State quantitative conditional sota_delta with assumptions and no measured or exponent gain invented.

Read preferred IDEA-20260905-d76d38 and preserved predecessor66cf9a in full; route new H/EXP only through RQ-DREG-72c2b0. Preserve source mechanism, all predictions/controls, corrected monomial baseline and8/10/12-bit laterS3 boundary.

Freeze actual ordered generators, coefficient fields, polynomial versus quotient rings, all membership/field equations, grading, homogenization, term/module and full-column orders before defining a consequence. Ordinary polynomial ideals and Boolean/odd-prime quotient presentations remain different objects.

Define the iterated bounded-degree consequence space, its finite target subspace and the candidate-specific earliest derivation degree precisely. Separate a one-shot span of original-generator multiples, iterated closure and maximum degree in an expanded certificate; do not equate them without an explicit interface proof.

Keep polynomial output degree, candidate earliest derivation degree, last observed fall, certified last fall, output-basis degree and solving degree distinct. Read the actual primary definitions and hypotheses; never identify first observed closure fall with a native first-fall syzygy definition merely by name.

Every minimum requires a positive derivation trace and complete lower-rung nonmembership certificates for the same consequence at every searched degree, using all ambient columns and a certified fixed point of the chosen closure. A full-rank matrix alone, selected columns or a failed heuristic search is not a nonmembership certificate.

Freeze deterministic target consequence selection and a canonical complete finite generating description or explicitly bounded target set, with all basis-change maps. If claiming a complete persistence/barcode object, define its maps, equivalence and completeness; a chosen list of interesting consequences is not the whole object.

Preserve the homogeneous monomial baseline: ordinary ideal monomial membership by divisibility, derivation at its own degree, no higher derivation requirement, full bounded ideal-monomial span. Nulls remain separate from this baseline.

Retain tiny integer-coefficient ideals with a planted low-degree consequence appearing late, a matched complete-intersection control, equal-output-degree fixtures and equal-homogeneous-Hilbert-data comparisons with explicit Hilbert object/equality certificates. A generic scalar degree-gap example alone does not supply every required comparison.

Retain an early fall followed by an arbitrarily later one as the known-false family; freeze concrete finite members and a finite degree ceiling sufficient to expose both within admitted cells. A quiet sequence of rungs or low output degree is not a stopping proof. Where the ceiling is reached report a lower bound/right-censoring, not a certified last fall.

Preserve separate Boolean and odd-prime panels and field-specific support/degree matched nulls. Declare representation level of support and coefficient sampling; exact nonzero F2-support randomization can be degenerate. Record attempted/null-unavailable cases rather than silently change the matching predicate or force null ranks.

Retain the later prime-field S3 panel at8,10,12-bit fields. Freeze exact primes, curves/bases/targets, eligibility, formulas, sample and null counts, seeds and calibration/holdout policy before protocol review; source does not specify those counts, so determine and disclose them rather than invent inherited counts.

Charge full-column construction, closure iterations, all candidate and failed searches, rank/nonmembership certificates, lower-rung storage, coefficient/degree growth, witness expansion, canonicalization and independent checking. Report arithmetic and bit operations, CPU/wall, peak live/RSS bytes, witness/stored/spill/I/O bytes. No free reuse or unmeasured solver speedup.

Compare actual contracts of EXP-INSTR-f1aebb, EXP-PFDR-cbdefb, H-PFDR-2139a5/EXP-PFDR-845d33,a76b91,f32e6c and EXP-DREG-3e5927. The new object is consequence-wise persistence/minimality, not the existing meter card, slope ladder, claim-typing audit or h-torsion solver transform. Return revise if the proposed contract collapses to an existing owner.

If a theorem is invoked to infer true last fall or solving degree, retain all assumptions and a global completeness certificate such as a properly certified complete basis/interface. A finite table or two adjacent equal spaces alone cannot assert eventual stabilization or negate an unspecified O(1) bound.

Keep actual DREG n12,15,18 and at least3seed completion requirements, source old infrastructure stops and full-column/null obligations separate; no old rank or forced-null claim is validated here. PATH is advisory; any SDEG cost contribution requires its separate verifier/precommit/launch and matchedcost gates.

Read preferred IDEA-20260905-d8c55f and predecessor f31728 in full; route new H/EXP only through RQ-DREG-0e10c8. Preserve the integral-model, exact rank/minor/Fitting and characteristic-torsion question, not an empirical p-sweep.

Supply an actual fixed integral polynomial presentation, base ring (Z or an explicitly localized ring), ordered generators and all field/digit/membership relations. Freeze its full bounded Macaulay row and column modules, degree convention and every coefficient-specialization map before any transfer assertion.

Write a commuting specialization diagram with exact maps from the supplied integral object to each compared presentation. Degree/order/quotient changes, denominators, localization exclusions and basis changes require explicit certificates. Matching dimensions or matching ranks is not model equivalence; if no common model exists the transfer remains unavailable.

Distinguish rational-rank upper and lower certificates. A nonzero rank-r minor supplies a lower bound away from its divisors; certify the rational upper bound as well. Distinguish a conservative exceptional-prime superset from an exact list using sufficient determinantal-divisor/Fitting or Smith-form evidence and independent checking.

For exact exceptional sets, freeze treatment of rank0, zero/rectangular matrices, primitive minors, gcd/content, factorization certificates and prime powers. A prime dividing a selected witness minor need not actually be exceptional; preserve false-positive candidates and test/check exactness as declared.

Specify whether torsion is in the cokernel or a defined homology/quotient. Do not call a kernel vector in a free integer module torsion merely because it reduces to zero. Give saturation/primitivity and lifting witnesses, and an explicit exact sequence for extra modular syzygies or failure of kernel base change.

Retain the full corrected baseline diag(I_r,0): unit maximal minor, vanishing larger minors, equal rank overQ and all fields and empty exceptional set. Keep the primitive-minor matched null as a separate control.

Retain2x2 and4x4 planted integer matrices with torsion orders2 and3, diag(1,2) as a known-false unconditional-transfer control, primitive-maximal-minor nulls, and one tiny common-model chain atD<=6. Freeze all actual matrices/polynomials, primes, heights, degrees, seeds and counts before protocol review; no source family may be discarded to fit reservations.

Define support and coefficient-height matching exactly. Check feasibility of primitive-minor nulls under that predicate; for some diagonal support/height strata such a null may be unavailable. Preserve diag(1,2) as the separate required known-false object, never claim a nonexistent null or silently relax height/support matching.

Search for equal-rank or equal-exceptional-set observations with different invariant factors, torsion orders, kernel embeddings or costs; keep the distinguishing data. Identify rational free classes versus new modular classes by complete certificates, not a modular rank coincidence.

Charge discovery of rational rank and integral normal forms/minors, all failed candidate minors, integer coefficient growth, content/gcd and factorization, unimodular/basis maps, prime-specific tests, witness construction and independent verification. Report bit operations and actual coefficient/witness bytes, CPU/wall and peak live/RSS/storage/spill costs.

Read actual H-PFDR-9aadc0/EXP-PFDR-20ee58 and EXP-PFDR-fd901a. They own the digit twin and empirical fixed-shape p-calibration; this question requires a fixed supplied integral object and complete exceptional-prime certificate. Preserve their shared-meter and review owners. Return revise if the contract merely reruns their rank profiles.

Do not inherit the odd-prime twin claim that a Koszul-only null rank is forced or old Boolean counts without independent source/definition validation. Neither Boolean Weil descent nor an arbitrary prime-digit system is automatically a specialization of the other.

Any proposed polynomial/kernel or rank-specialization theorem needs explicit assumptions, exact correctness/completeness and size/cost obligations, with an independently checked concrete instance and formal target where useful. An abstract lemma under assumed matrix equality does not prove the supplied diagram.

Scope any all-good-primes claim to this fixed presentation and declaredD. Do not infer behavior at largerD, chain length, cryptographic scale or allECDLP models. DREG and SDEG measurement/admission residuals stay owned; PATH remains advisory.
